Before any PR, read root `AGENTS.md` and complete every canonical gate checklist. Fix findings, rerun affected gates, and include each canonical skill's exact report format in the PR. Never claim a pass unless it was actually reviewed.

- `.agents/skills/over-engineering/SKILL.md`
